common.footerTagline: Axeriva — Workforce Management for Field Service Businesses
common.linkFallback: If the button doesn't work, copy this link into your browser:

welcome.subject: Welcome to Axeriva
welcome.body: Your account for {{companyName}} is ready. You can now add employees, create projects, and start scheduling shifts.
welcome.help: Need help getting started? Just reply to this email.

verifyEmail.subject: Confirm your email for Axeriva
verifyEmail.intro: Thanks for signing up for Axeriva!
verifyEmail.body: Please confirm your email address to finish setting up your account.
verifyEmail.expiry: This link expires in {{hours}} hours. If you didn't create an Axeriva account, you can safely ignore this email.

passwordReset.subject: Reset your Axeriva password
passwordReset.body: We received a request to reset your Axeriva password.
passwordReset.ignore: If you didn't request this, you can safely ignore this email — your password won't be changed.

invitation.subject: You've been invited to join {{companyName}} on Axeriva
invitation.body: You've been invited to join {{companyName}} on Axeriva. Click below to set your password and activate your account.
invitation.expiry: This link expires in {{days}} days. If you weren't expecting this invitation, you can safely ignore this email.

common.manage: You can view past invoices or change your plan any time from the Subscription page in Axeriva.

subscriptionRenewed.subject: Your Axeriva subscription renewed — {{amount}}
subscriptionRenewed.body: {{companyName}} is on the {{planName}} plan for another billing period. Here are the details:

invoicePaid.subject: Payment received for your plan change — {{amount}}
invoicePaid.intro: Thanks — we've received your payment for the plan change.
invoicePaid.body: {{companyName}} is now on the {{planName}} plan. This invoice covers the difference for the rest of the current billing period:

invoiceFailed.subject: We couldn't collect your Axeriva payment — {{amount}}
invoiceFailed.subjectFinal: Action needed — your Axeriva payment didn't go through ({{amount}})
invoiceFailed.introFirst: We tried to collect the payment for {{companyName}}'s Axeriva subscription, and it didn't go through.
invoiceFailed.introRepeat: We still haven't been able to collect the payment for {{companyName}}'s Axeriva subscription.
invoiceFailed.retryScheduled: The next automatic attempt is scheduled for {{date}}. It can only succeed if there's a working payment method on file, so updating your details now is the surest way to avoid an interruption.
invoiceFailed.retryNone: No further automatic attempt is scheduled. To keep your subscription running, please update your payment details.
invoiceFailed.consequence: If the payment isn't completed, the subscription ends and Axeriva switches to read-only: your data stays exactly as it is, but nobody on the team can make changes until billing is sorted out.

subscriptionConfirmed.subject: Your {{planName}} subscription is active
subscriptionConfirmed.body: {{companyName}} is now on the {{planName}} plan. You have full access to employees, projects, scheduling, and time tracking.
subscriptionConfirmed.manage: You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime from the Subscription page in Axeriva.

inApp.title: Your {{planName}} subscription is active
inApp.body: {{companyName}} now has full access. You can manage the plan any time.
